title: Run validation from Go

scenes.heading: A partial report still matters
voice: Some checks passed before GPU cluster validation was interrupted.
The dashboard needs to show what ran and why the full run stopped.

scenes.heading: Pass desired and observed state
scenes.sub: Use the deployed recipe and snapshot
voice: Load the deployed recipe and a snapshot of the same cluster.
Your Go service supplies both to AICR with credentials for the validation target.

scenes.heading: Run the selected phases in Go
scenes.sub: The call returns results and an error
voice: Call ValidateState for the phases your workflow needs.
The call can return completed phase results together with an error, such as cancellation during a later phase.

scenes.heading: Keep the result and the error
scenes.sub: Show the real state of the run
voice: Render the completed results and the error in the portal.
When the run stops early, mark it interrupted and retain the details the operator can already use.

viewer: Go developer building a validation dashboard
payoff: A Go portal shows completed checks and an interruption together, making a partial run useful.
